title: Five-year effect of sequential argon-Nd:YAG prophylactic laser peripheral iridotomy on corneal endothelial cell density in Japanese eyes with narrow angles

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

indication: Narrow drainage angles in Japanese eyes (PACS or PAC in 41/69 treated eyes, others by gonioscopic/UBM criteria at the attending specialist's discretion); no previous ocular surgery, no corneal disease, no clinically relevant cataract; prophylactic sequential argon-Nd:YAG laser peripheral iridotomy

groups.description: Eyes treated with prophylactic sequential argon-Nd:YAG laser peripheral iridotomy (pLPIsequential-treated eyes; one eye per subject; prospective observational study, standard first-line laser procedure, no investigational agent)

series.baseline_label: Baseline = CECD of the study eye at entry, before pLPIsequential (Table 3 row 'Baseline'; Methods: specular microscopy at enrollment, then at 1-year intervals)
series.notes: Table 3 column 'pLPIsequential-treated eyes / CECD (cells/mm2)'; footnote: means ± standard deviations (percent change from the baseline). Times 1-5 years converted as years x 12. Per-visit n is not tabulated (Results: 8 subjects left the study at 3 years and 7 at 4 years).

exclusions.what: Table 3 'pLPIsequential-untreated eyes' series (67 eyes of 67 subjects)
exclusions.reason: Unoperated eyes followed without any procedure (not indicated for, or declined, laser iridotomy); protocol inclusion 1 requires ECD after a surgical procedure and unoperated control eyes are excluded

exclusions.what: Percent change from baseline in parentheses of Table 3 cells
exclusions.reason: The same table gives absolute ECD for the group; the absolute ECD series is used

exclusions.what: Tables 4 and 5 (mixed-effect model estimates of CECD change rates)
exclusions.reason: Model estimates, not measured group means at follow-up times

notes: Role: laser peripheral iridotomy is the study's standard (conventional first-line) procedure without an investigational agent, so the treated eyes are a control-role group; the comparator group is unoperated and excluded.
Follow-up numbers fall after 2 years (Results); the series n is the number of eyes at the reference time.
